name: Actual Budget
tagline: Envelope budgeting that keeps your finances on your own server.
description: Actual is a fast budgeting app built on envelope budgeting: give each part of your income a job, track your accounts, and sync between your devices through your own server.
postInstall: It needs HTTPS, except when opened from the server itself: put it behind a reverse proxy with a certificate, then enter that address as the port's domain in Apps, Edit, Ports, so Open uses it.
Then open it and set the server password.
